title: Ruleset: city
description: rules/<id>/city.yaml: the city's prosperity rebuilt from the recruit triggers, and the File City screen a finished game continues on (apps/session: CityAdapter; game/story: prosperity.hpp).

points_variable.description: The story variable that holds the points.

recruit_trigger.description: A species is recruited when trigger recruit_trigger + its number is set.

end_species.description: The species number where the count stops (not included).

min_level.description: The lowest level that counts (3 rookie).

level_offset.description: A counted species adds its level minus this.

one_point_species.description: Species that add one point whatever their level.

cup_variable.description: The story variable of the registered cup.

no_cup_from.description: From this value up the cup variable holds no cup.

registration_triggers.description: Triggers cleared when no cup is registered.

cleared_map.description: The File City screens, first match wins: the first whose triggers are all set.
